G u i d e b o o k
Who am I?
Hey, my name is Vanris. I’m just a regular person who once struggled with IELTS too. At ﬁrst, I 
thought IELTS was simply about “being good at English,” but I quickly realized it’s more about 
strategies, practice, and the right mindset. I’ve been through the ups and downs, feeling lost with 
the test format, wasting time on the wrong methods, until I ﬁnally ﬁgured out how to prepare the 
smart way.
I wrote this ebook for people like you who need IELTS for different purposes: studying abroad, 
applying for scholarships, getting a Working Holiday Visa (WHV), or simply wanting to improve 
your English. My goal is simple: to help you save time, money, and effort by learning IELTS the 
right way.
Me at The University of Hull, United Kingdom during my undergraduate time

So, what is IELTS?
IELTS:
IELTS (International English Language Testing System) is one of the most widely recognized 
English tests in the world. It’s used by thousands of universities, companies, and governments to 
measure your English ability. The test covers 4 skills:
Listening
Reading
Writing
Speaking
There are 2 types of IELTS:
Academic: for those applying to universities or professional registration.
General Training (GT): often required for work, migration, or Working Holiday Visas.
Scores range from 0 to 9 (Band Score). You’ll get a score for each skill, plus an overall average.
How much does IELTS cost?
Here’s the part most people don’t like… IELTS in Indonesia costs around IDR 3,150,000 – 
3,500,000 (depending on the test center).
 That’s not cheap, which is why preparing properly is so important.

Where can you take IELTS in Indonesia?
You can register through IDP or British Council (BC). Test centers are available in many cities, 
including and not limited to:
Bandung
Jakarta
Bali
Surabaya
Yogyakarta
You can also choose between Computer-Delivered IELTS (results in 3–5 days) or Paper-Based 
IELTS (results in about 13 days). Just go with whichever format you feel more comfortable with.
What’s inside this ebook?
This ebook will guide you through practical ways to study IELTS, covering all four skills: 
Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking. Each section includes strategies, tips, and examples 
you can immediately apply.
My aim is:
If you’re a beginner, you’ll know exactly where to start.
If you’ve already studied before, you’ll sharpen your strategies.
If you’re on a deadline (for WHV, scholarships, or university applications), you’ll study more 
effectively and focus on what really matters.
By the end of this ebook, IELTS won’t feel like an impossible monster anymore. It’s just another 
skill you can learn step by step, with the right approach.
LET’S START!!!!
Listening
What is the Listening Test?
The Listening section is the ﬁrst part of the IELTS test. It lasts around 30 minutes, plus 10 
minutes for transferring answers (if you do paper-based).
Total questions: 40
Score: Each correct answer = 1 point (then converted into Band 1–9).
Format: 4 recordings, each with different accents (British, Australian, American, etc).
Structure of the Listening Test
You will hear 4 sections:
Conversation

hotel, asking for directions.
